eclipse-arlott.name: Eclipse Arlott
eclipse-arlott.description: Half-Demon. A tragic figure with white hair and eyes of mismatched colors. An outsider to both demons and humans. Arlott, born of human and demon blood, was betrayed by both races. At death's door, he was saved by a human girl named Mila and found peace in a quiet life. But their happiness was short-lived. When the Church of Light executed Mila for helping him, Arlott, consumed by rage, broke through the ranks of knights in the church and laid Mila to rest in a place filled with their shared memories... (official introduction)

ember-irithel.name: Ember Irithel
ember-irithel.description: (In-game Info) To any outsider, it was the most disastrous fire in history. Just when all seemed lost, with the forest on the verge of consuming Irithel and her tiger, a rainstorm hit without any warning, quenching the unprecedented flames. As the scorched wood cracked and fell away, Irithel rose slowly from the dissipating smoke and smoldering embers. Her head hung low, marked by ghastly wounds, and the crimson glow of her horn signaled imminent danger. Beside her, Leo emerged from the charred timber, vigorously shaking off dirt and ash. The tempered steel scales on the back of his neck unfurled one by one, gleaming with an eerie chill. He took a deliberate step forward, stretching, as flames danced from his tail.

eos-silvanna.name: Eos Silvanna
eos-silvanna.description: (In-game Info) After Silvanna's father fell ill, she took over as the ruler of the Moniyan Empire. However, the weight of her new responsibility lef her lost and confused, unsure of what the future held. When caught in a web of intrigue, it can be difficult to know what you truly want. Silvanna was no exception. As she began to navigate the unfamiliar world of politics and deal with outspoken officials, she had to find her own way of doing things. But as we know, Silvanna is a fighter. A moment of confusion won't make her give up or lose faith. When the empire is faced with internal and external crises, Silvanna will always be at the forefront, leading of charge. "I am the very symbol of Moniyan," Silvanna declared. Her promise to protect her country is a commitment that can never be broken. With the flag held high in her hand, she will defend Moniyan until the end of time.

She alongside other guards fight against The Light's Order Team in order to imprison Tigreal thinking he is the one behind the crimes committed against the Moniyan Empire. She has white hair ended on a pony tail which is supported by a steel hairband. wears a knight eyes cover and a neck armor that covers part of her left shoulder; on body a black combat full body suit, which the end of the sleeves are blue; under it has a gray blouse and blue pants; on her head wears a navy vibes hat; one of her arms is a tech arm in which carries a long sword.

With a steadfast commitment to justice, and though she may be serious, Erza has quite a fondness for sweets. What sort of wonders await Erza, who found herself in the Land of Dawn after being drawn into a space-time rift during a full moon?

freya.name: Freya
freya.description: Freya, the Valkyrie of Nost Gal, is a legendary goddess. When she descends, it means a great soul has escaped the mortal life.
freya.story: Valkyrie Paragraph 1:In the far northern reaches of Nost Gal, there is a legend: when a warrior dies on the battlefield, the goddess of war Freya will come down from heaven, kiss the spirit of the fallen, and lead it to the Temple of Heroes, where former warriors can have a new life.Valkyrie Paragraph 2:Freya herself is an outstanding warrior. She can both attack and defend with her sword and shield, and at a critical moment in battle she can transform into a halberd and smash the enemy formation. --------------------------------------------Dark Rose:As a chosen one with the ability to see into the future, Freya foresaw a rebirth of the Land of Dawn at an early age. Paragraph 2: Realizing that she had been given a duty, she gathered the heroes of the different planes to form a community named "Scarlet Blad". Together with other chosen ones, Freya fought against the scourge of the future. The spirit of "Scarlet Blade" has been passed down to the present day, and will be passed down to the next generation, inspiring descendants. --------------------------------------------Dragon Slayer:No one alive remembers her true name, yet her existence has been passed on in folk tales and legends through many ages. She is said to have slain a mighty dragon of the past, and in awe they call her the 'Dragon Slayer'.Paragraph 2:She wields a blade of darkness, an enchanted shield, and from her back protrude the wings of the ancient beast she once slew. Some scholars believe she has the ability to assimilate the powers of those she slays; while others she is a terrible, wicked dragon herself.

guinevere.name: Guinevere
guinevere.description: The Baroque family is one of the few nobles on the Land of Dawn. The most prestigious skill of theirs, fencing, the family's forte, discourages countless opponts from even thinking about attacking. In addition, beauty and wisdom are also the most perfect genetic signs of the Baroque family, just like the eternal beauty and love of Violet. World-famous as Baroque family|s fencing is, young Guinevere doesnt't like it at all. Just like other girls, she is naturally fond of gorgeous things. From youth, she was sent to the Magic Academy. Relying anti-gravity magic, when Guinevere was 10 years old, she successfully combined mental perception with super energy and invented multiple magic effects - magic superpower. Such a breakthrough made Guinevere more passionate about magic, and she often experimented with her new magic on her brother Lancelot. No matter hom Lancelot hid, he would always be found by his sister. Therefore, Lancelot was often caught in out of nowhere. During his childhood, his sister was always causing him headaches, but Lancelot still loves Guinevere. He always shows a smile to this beloved sister. But every time Lancelot thinks of his little sister's magic experiment, he would wear a bitter sm,ile. Recently, something has been plaguing Guinevere making her uneasy. It is said that the Paxley nobles who have a very high magical status have proposed marriage to the Baroque family. Guinevere is undoubtedly the most suitable choice and Guinevere's father seems to be very willing to go through with the marriage. But the reluctant Guinevere suddenly thinks of an idea - She hopes to find her brother Lanselot...

kaja.name: Kaja
kaja.description: (In-game Info) "The Celestial Palace, home of the gods, was once a bustling city patrolled by innumerable Nazar guardians. Any demon who dared approach the city would be overwhelmed by their peerless flying speed and bound by their fearsome lightning whips which would strip their victims of all magical abilities. No demon could escape when pursued by these divine warriors, and thus perpetual peace was maintained in the Celestial Palace. As their leader, Kaja was able to refine the power of lighting into pure energy to control as he so desired, inflicting catastrophic damage to all enemies who faced him, and was charged with directly protecting the ruler of the city. Countless eons ago, after the ruler completed the creation of the city's guardians and departed, the city gradually fell into a state of ruin. When Uranus was activated, the ruler of the Celestial Palace handed down new orders to the Nazar - to drive the evil demons from the city and rebuild the Celestial Palace in anticipation of the master's return."

selena.name: Selena
selena.description: At the south of the Monian Empire, a bottomless abyss is carved into the desert landscape. The locals call this place the Abyss of Shadows. Few know that deep within the Dark Abyss, the most terrifying demon of the Dawn Earth is sealed — the Lord of the Abyss. Over the centuries, the seal of the Abyss has slowly faded, giving way to the ravenous will of the Abyss. The demons strengthened their control over the darkness. Many fanatics offered sacrifices to the Abyss, unknowingly feeding the demons formed from dark energy, always hiding within the shadows. Selena, a young dark elf, was offered to them as a sacrifice in exchange for dark energy. The Abyss Demon filled Selena with despair and pain, piercing every cell of her body. Just as Selena was nearly consumed by darkness, a miracle occurred. A mysterious warm blue light enveloped her and seemed to struggle with the dark abyss for control over her body. When Selena awoke, she found herself still lying in the Abyss, but her skin now emitted a strange blue glow, and her once lavender eyes were filled with a majestic crimson radiance — the Abyss Demon was resting inside her. Then the Will of the Abyss spoke: This girl is deeply loved, and that love protected her from being consumed by darkness. The Abyss and the Moon God, two opposing forces, have reached balance within her body. An ancient and deep voice echoed in the minds of the demons: Leave this girl to me. She will become the strongest warrior of the Abyss! The demons obeyed the command and left Selena. She forgot her past, but quickly discovered that she could manipulate the dark magic of the Abyss. She could absorb the power of the Abyss into her body to transform into a demoness capable of tearing enemies apart. The Will of the Abyss echoed in her voice, granting Selena unquestionable authority over the Abyss demons. Even Alice, the proud Queen of Blood Magic, felt uncertain when she looked at the dark young elf — not only because Alice could sense the terrifying power lying within this seemingly cute and mischievous girl named Selena.

tigreal.name: Tigreal
tigreal.description: (In-game Info) Tigreal is the Captain of the Imperial Capital's Moniyan Captain of Knights. Even as a child, he wanted nothing more than to become a great knight of the Empire. From his youth Tigreal was a loyal believer in the Lord of Light. He swore to become a member of the Knight's Order to defend the status and symbol of the Moniyan Empire throughout the Land of Dawn. He dedicated all his time to training. In each of their training simulations and tests Tigreal's performance became the benchmark that no other knight's could surpass. His mentors were the most revered of all the Imperial Knights. In order to prove himself and surpass them, he dedicated more time and energy than most people possess to his betterment; even the smallest mistakes in his training would be corrected and practice repeatedly in h in his free time. Eventually, his mentors declared him the Captain with the highest potential in all of the Knight's Order. His mentors' comments gave Tigreal complete confidence in his abilities. Even the strongest of heroes, however, is not without weakness. While hunting demons during one of their trial missions Tigreal showed the slightest amount of compassion, hesitating to make a kill. In that moment of hesitation, he was ambushed by the demons and gravely injured. He watched helplessly as his mentors sacrificed themselves to save him. It was this mission that made Tigreal understand that if he wanted his name recorded in the histories of the land, he still had a long path ahead of him. After the returning to the empire, Tigreal became even more strict with himself. He required each of his men to come back from every mission without a single loss, and wouldn't tolerate a single mistake from any of his subordinates. Ever since then the Paladin Tigreal can be seen at the frontlines of the battle, where he has never been defeated. Even the most evil of enemies don't dare to provoke Tigreal in battle, because they know to do so would be to suffer his merciless assault. A staunch believer in the Lord of Light, he became a pillar of the Order of Knights, his name synonymous with bravery and fearlessness. In order to recognize his courage, the empire bestowed upon him the title of Warrior of Dawn. Tigreal has constantly sought out the bravest warriors of the land, and in his mind there is none better than Alucard. For a long time, however, he has been unable to convince Alucard to leave the Temple of Light and join him. He knows that Alucard is unable to move on from the deaths of his parents. Each time he walks up the steps to the Temple of Light, he does so with a heart full of regret.

After the returning to the empire, Tigreal became even more strict with himself. He required each of his men to come back from every mission without a single loss, and wouldn't tolerate a single mistake from any of his subordinates. Ever since then the Paladin Tigreal can be seen at the frontlines of the battle, where he has never been defeated. Even the most evil of enemies don't dare to provoke Tigreal in battle, because they know to do so would be to suffer his merciless assault. A staunch believer in the Lord of Light, he became a pillar of the Order of Knights, his name synonymous with bravery and fearlessness. In order to recognize his courage, the empire bestowed upon him the title of Warrior of Dawn. Tigreal has constantly sought out the bravest warriors of the land, and in his mind there is none better than Alucard. For a long time, however, he has been unable to convince Alucard to leave the Temple of Light and join him. He knows that Alucard is unable to move on from the deaths of his parents. Each time he walks up the steps to the Temple of Light, he does so with a heart full of regret.

Corrupted by the power of the Abyss, he is no longer content with being a mere shadow in the realm of night. Now, Tsukuyomi seeks to establish his supremacy over death, the Great Underworld.
